source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: [Snarling Protector](vsdata:ability/thousand-sons.maulerfiend.snarling-protector) allows a 1 CP discount on [Heroic Intervention](vsdata:ability/core.heroic-intervention) for the Maulerfiend and allows an earlier use in the same phase. Other units can still use it that phase. When the Maulerfiend charges, it can re-roll the [Charge roll](vsdata:core-rule/charge-phase) if an engaged friendly PSYKER is up to 12″ away. By taking the re-roll, it commits to a [Charge move](vsdata:core-rule/charge-move) ending engaged with a foe that is in combat with that PSYKER.
